results.title: An assumption whose key no input supplies
results.evidence: a contract clause whose key no input supplies is correctly not a violation, and `Contract.unchecked_inputs` names it — ['ltv'] — but the engine only LOGS it. `ExecutionResult` carries `boundary_ok` and `boundary_violations` and nothing about what was never checked, so a caller cannot tell a boundary that held from one that never applied.
